summary: I tried to refute DONE and could not. All three parts of the proposal are in the code and in the current build output. (1) The thread and draft route chunks preload at idle after the shell paints, first in the queue, ahead of the palette and settings. handleWelcome starts the thread chunk, and outside hosted mode prewarms the thread detail, before it awaits the shell snapshot. (2) Sidebar rows, inbox rows and every New-thread control preload on intent; the router uses defaultPreload 'intent'. (3) modulePreload is back on, with a resolver that only handles JS hosts. The built boot chunk now preloads all 146 deps of ChatThreadRouteView (145 for the draft route, lexical included) in one round, and index.html has only the 4 boot-chain modulepreloads. The thread and draft routes now use lazyRouteComponent, which the router awaits before it commits the route. That removes the 300 ms Suspense-throttle caveat the earlier verifier raised. The fix commits (60633eff3, 3ce80cee6) are ancestors of 7bc39eec3, so the Hub's vendored build has them too. I found one minor inefficiency and one gap in test coverage; neither changes the DONE status.

evidence.note: ShellIdlePreloads: the thread and draft route chunks are the first idle task, then the command palette, then settings. Mounted at :111. Skipped on the phone tier.

Starts after primary-shell-painted (capped at 5 s), runs one task per idle period, and skips on saveData or networks slower than 4g. The phase-already-reached path is safe: it starts synchronously before cancelPhaseWait is assigned, and the default is a no-op.

When the bootstrap redirect applies, preloadRouteChunk(THREAD_ROUTE_ID) (:286) and, outside hosted mode, prewarmThreadDetailSubscription (:287) run before `await ensureEnvironmentConnectionBootstrapped` (:290).
Calls router.loadRouteChunk, which goes to route.options.component.preload(), the same lazyRouteComponent load the navigation awaits (router-core load-client.js:21-37).
lazyRouteComponent. The loader returns early on preload, so hovering opens no streams. preloadStaleTime is 0.
The draft route is also a lazyRouteComponent.
Hover and press warm the thread chunk, plus a detail retain after a 120 ms dwell. preloadDraftRoute warms the draft chunk.
Thread and draft rows preload on pointerenter and pointerdown.
Inbox rows use the same hover and press intents. The auditor did not list this, but it covers the second sidebar surface.
The New thread button preloads the draft route on pointerenter and focus. SidebarChatList.tsx:150-151 and SidebarProjectHeader.tsx:179-180 do the same.
Keyboard-shortcut and other new drafts start the draft chunk while the defaults RPC runs.
Returns deps for hostType 'js' and [] for html. Tested in viteBuild/buildPlugins.test.ts:31-47.

Current build output (built 2026-10-14 21:45, after HEAD). The ChatThreadRouteView import's __vite__mapDeps lists 146 files, including lexical and composer chunks; DraftChatThreadRouteView lists 145. dist/index.html carries only boot, rolldown-runtime, boot-vendor and main as modulepreloads. ChatLayoutRouteView is bundled into boot (3ce80cee6), so preloading only the leaf route leaves no parent-layout gap.
Deep-linked documents start the matched route chunks during the root beforeLoad.

fixDefects: Minor nit, no correctness impact. handleWelcome checks only shouldApplyBootstrapThreadRedirect (pathname '/', not phone, not hosted home) before it prewarms (RootAppShell.tsx:276-287). It does not check handledBootstrapThreadIdRef, which is read only at :321 after the snapshot. Each new connection re-emits the welcome (client-runtime rpc/serverState.ts:165-166 into welcomeAtom). So a desktop user who sits on '/' after the bootstrap redirect was handled (for example after the active thread was deleted or archived and the view fell back to '/') gets a thread-detail subscription to the bootstrap thread on every reconnect. Nothing consumes it, and threadDetailPrewarm.ts releases it after 10 s. The chunk preload on that path is a free no-op. Coverage gap: no component or browser test asserts the welcome-time preload/prewarm ordering or the ShellIdlePreloads task order. Only the helper modules are unit-tested (shellIdlePreload.test.ts, routeChunkPreload.test.ts, threadDetailPrewarm.test.ts). The hosted skip of the prewarm (:287) looks deliberate and matches the AGENTS.md hosted lifecycle ownership rule. The route loader still prewarms in hosted mode at navigation time.
implementationSketch: Optional nit fix in apps/web/src/components/RootAppShell.tsx EventRouter.handleWelcome. Gate the early prewarm (and optionally the chunk preload) on `handledBootstrapThreadIdRef.current !== payload.bootstrapThreadId`, the same check the redirect uses at :321. Better, extract a small pure predicate into RootAppShell.logic.ts (e.g. shouldPrewarmBootstrapThread({pathname, tier, hostedHome, handledThreadId, bootstrapThreadId})) and use it at both sites so the two cannot drift. Add a RootAppShell.logic.test.ts case: a handled bootstrap thread on '/' does not prewarm. Optionally add a browser test that mounts EventRouter with a mocked welcome and checks that preloadRouteChunk and prewarm run before ensureEnvironmentConnectionBootstrapped resolves, then don't run again on a second welcome.
